header.description: J-space systems (2,604): wormhole class, system effect, and static wormholes, one row per system.
sources: class: V24.01 client static data, native/systems.jsonl.gz field wormholeClassID (system names from native/localization_fsd_en-us.jsonl.gz)
effect and statics of normal J-space systems: EveJS v0.12.9 tools/DatabaseCreator/staticTables/explorationWormholeStatic/data.json (environmentFamily, staticSlots)
statics of the 100 shattered systems: EVE University wiki, List of shattered systems (oldid 222738, fetched 2026-10-12); EveJS has no statics for these systems
effect beacon typeIDs: SDE 3396210 group 920 (Class N <effect> Effects)
static type codes and typeIDs: SDE 3396210 types ("Wormhole <code>")

crossChecks.shatteredClassAgreement: 98 of 100 (client, EveJS, wiki). Disagreements: J004686 (wiki 3, client 2), J011376 (wiki 3, client 4)
crossChecks.shatteredEffectAgreement: EveJS beacon/family against the wiki: 98 of 100 (J005926: family Pulsar, beacon Red Giant; J010569: family Red Giant, beacon Wolf Rayet; the wiki says Red Giant for both). The wiki is used for the 100 shattered systems.
crossChecks.shatteredStaticsInEveJS: 0 of 100 (EveJS has no statics for shattered systems)

header.effectNote: effect: for the 100 shattered systems the effect is the wiki list (oldid 222738); for the others the EveJS effect beacon. effectTypeID is the SDE group 920 beacon of (effect, effectClass); effectClass is the beacon strength class and equals the system class for most systems.
